subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: “Be a good sport, Tessie,” Mrs. Delacroix called and Tessie said, “All of us took the same chance.” “Shut up, Tessie,” Bill Hutchinson said. “Well, everyone, that was done pretty fast,” Mr. Summer said, “and now we’ve got to be hurrying a little more to get done in time.”
guide_solution: Changing the form of speech Mrs. Delacroix advised Tessie to be a good sport. Tessie said that all of them had taken the same chance. Bill Hutchinson ordered Tessie to shut up. Mr. Summer agreed and told everyone that had been done pretty fast and then they had got to be hurrying a little more to get done in time.
